value.title: Map rotation is explicit and location recovery is predictable
value.statement: Two-finger map rotation is disabled by default and changes only through the dedicated toolbar toggle. Disabling rotation returns the camera north-up and keeps tilt disabled. When enabled, pinch and rotate detectors run together so an immediate two-finger twist does not require a hold or sequential finger placement. The location action always resets north, raises zoom to at least 12 without zooming out, and when no current fix exists centers on the first layer with a valid finite extent at zoom 12 regardless of extent size. The MapLibre camera cannot go below 7.5 (pinch, buttons, restore and fit bounds). Layer DEFAULT_MIN_ZOOM remains 0. Phone, landscape and tablet map layouts include the same content with a track toggle and walk panel. Right-edge tools reflow into columns using actual view height, including orientation changes without Activity recreation. The creation menu has its own bottom row and cannot overlap the tools or walk controls. The compact walk panel sits at the bottom and moves above that row only while the creation menu is expanded; it exposes no GPS accuracy or overflow.
